name: rolementions
description: Tracks role mentions with daily stats and auto-protects sensitive roles from mention spam via timed mention blocks.
endUserDataStatement: Tracks role mention counts and cooldown timestamps in guild storage. Does not store personal end-user data or message contents.

configFields.label: Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel where mention activity and protection events are logged.

configFields.label: Auto-Protect
configFields.description: Automatically block mentions of protected roles when they are pinged.
